name: Federal Register API
tagline: Structured JSON access to official US Federal Register documents, rules, and notices.
description: Official REST API for the US Federal Register (federalregister.gov). Search and retrieve rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents, and public inspection items as structured JSON, including metadata, full text, and agency information. No authentication required for public read access; designed for government transparency and regulatory monitoring.

auth.details: No API key or authentication required for public read endpoints. Requests are made over HTTPS without credentials.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans. Fair-use rate limiting may apply (limits not formally published as a free-tier quota).

use_cases: search Federal Register documents by keyword, agency, or date
fetch full text and metadata for a specific FR document number
list recent rules and proposed rules for regulatory monitoring
retrieve public inspection documents before official publication
get agency-specific notices and presidential documents
